fixture_description: Additional exploratory synthetic multilingual source-retrieval challenge, written after prior C17 results were known. Fictional sources and labels were authored together by an AI agent before inference and have not been independently reviewed. It is not an external or unbiased holdout. Paired near-neighbor distractors have similar topics and distinct entities, numerical answers or exact ticket codes.
method: Exact dot-product of L2-normalized embeddings; no query prefix, matching source embed_texts; single full document per source; all 31 ranked; no reranking or generation. Ties broken by source id.
